acceptance_scenarios.case: unauthenticated participant calls a participant endpoint
acceptance_scenarios.expected: 401 and zero domain/event/outbox writes

acceptance_scenarios.case: authenticated participant without enrollment starts journey
acceptance_scenarios.expected: 403 ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED and zero writes

acceptance_scenarios.case: authorized operator publishes valid graph
acceptance_scenarios.expected: all versions published and four publication events/outbox routes committed atomically

acceptance_scenarios.case: publication command is repeated with same key and payload
acceptance_scenarios.expected: same response with replayed=true; no extra event or outbox row

acceptance_scenarios.case: published version is edited
acceptance_scenarios.expected: mutation rejected; a new version is required

acceptance_scenarios.case: operator enrolls participant and repeats command
acceptance_scenarios.expected: one enrollment, one journey instance and one initial projection

acceptance_scenarios.case: participant completes diagnostic with high scores and no uncertainty
acceptance_scenarios.expected: standard path persisted with one shared activity step

acceptance_scenarios.case: participant completes diagnostic with low dimension or at least two uncertain answers
acceptance_scenarios.expected: guided path persisted and uncertainty event exists when applicable

acceptance_scenarios.case: participant changes a diagnostic answer before completion
acceptance_scenarios.expected: new response revision linked to prior response; history preserved

acceptance_scenarios.case: invalid diagnostic option or missing required answer
acceptance_scenarios.expected: 422 and no result or path assignment

acceptance_scenarios.case: activity starts
acceptance_scenarios.expected: step state in_progress, one activity session and activity-started event

acceptance_scenarios.case: same content section acknowledgement is repeated
acceptance_scenarios.expected: accepted count and progress increase once only

acceptance_scenarios.case: quick-check answer references invalid option
acceptance_scenarios.expected: 422 INVALID_ANSWER_OPTION and no response event

acceptance_scenarios.case: wrong quick-check answer is submitted
acceptance_scenarios.expected: failed attempt and feedback; activity remains in progress; zero points

acceptance_scenarios.case: correct quick-check answer is submitted
acceptance_scenarios.expected: attempt passed, activity/path/journey completed, progress 1.0, exactly 7 points and required events

acceptance_scenarios.case: successful submission is repeated with same idempotency key
acceptance_scenarios.expected: identical response; ledger remains two entries totaling 7; no duplicate completion events

acceptance_scenarios.case: same idempotency key is reused with a different body
acceptance_scenarios.expected: 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED and no new effect

acceptance_scenarios.case: stale aggregate version is submitted concurrently
acceptance_scenarios.expected: 409 AGGREGATE_VERSION_CONFLICT and winning state preserved

acceptance_scenarios.case: event or outbox append is forced to fail
acceptance_scenarios.expected: all domain writes in that command roll back

acceptance_scenarios.case: operator from another organization requests result
acceptance_scenarios.expected: 404 and no information disclosure

acceptance_scenarios.case: authorized operator opens completed result
acceptance_scenarios.expected: diagnostic, path, activity, assessment, progress, points and event evidence are consistent and no credit interpretation is shown
